title: Branch Management
description: Create and manage your business's branches
name: Branch Name
noPermission: You don't have permission to manage Branches
planLimitReached: You've reached the branch limit for your current plan
planAtCapacity: Your current plan has reached its branch limit
nameTooLong: Branch name must be 100 characters or fewer
nameDuplicate: A branch with this name already exists
deleteConfirm: Branch "{name}" will be deleted. A branch with shifts, invoices or an open shift cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone.

isolation.title: Branch isolation
isolation.description: Each branch works as an independent business: its own items, customers, staff, sales, expenses and accounting. The main branch only sees a summary.
isolation.enableConfirm: Every branch will see only its own data, and you will work inside the branch picked in the branch switcher. You can turn it off later.
isolation.disableConfirm: Data goes back to being shared across the tenant.

publishDescription: Copy the selected records from the current branch to other branches.
publishMode: If a record already exists in the branch
publishModeCopyNew: Only add missing records (keep existing untouched)
publishModeUpdate: Add missing and update existing records
publishStockNote: Stock starts at zero in the target branch; add a stock adjustment.
creatingWithCopy: Creating the branch and copying settings, this may take a minute...
copySetupFromMain: Copy setup from the main branch
copySetupHint: Categories, brands, units, loyalty tiers, customer fields, expense categories/departments and shift patterns.

wizard.subtitle: Create the branch step by step; everything can be edited later.

stepHints.identity: Branch name, contact details and map location.
stepHints.warehouse: Every branch has its own warehouse, used to deduct stock on sale.
stepHints.tax: Optional. The branch's tax identity and invoice footer.
stepHints.data: Start empty, or copy what you choose from another branch.
stepHints.review: Review the details, then create the branch.

wizard.shortCodeHint: 2-6 letters or digits (A-Z, 0-9), shown as a badge on the branch card. Does not affect invoice numbering.
wizard.mapHint: Click the map to set the location. Used to limit employee check-ins to the radius.
wizard.mapUnavailable: The map could not be loaded
wizard.warehouseHint: This is the branch's default warehouse.
wizard.warehouseOwn: The warehouse belongs to this branch only; you cannot pick another branch's warehouse. Extra warehouses can be added later inside the branch.
wizard.taxNote: These are identity details of the branch. They do not change the tax rate or the existing print templates.
wizard.dataEmpty: Empty, I will set everything up myself
wizard.dataEmptyHint: Nothing is copied; the branch starts clean.
wizard.dataCopy: Copy what I choose from a branch
wizard.dataCopyHint: Pick the source branch and the groups to copy.
wizard.dataCopyUnavailable: Copying from another branch is available to the owner when branch isolation is on.
wizard.copyStockNote: Stock is not copied; it starts at zero.
wizard.reviewNote: The branch inherits the business activity. The branch manager is assigned later from the employees page.
wizard.doneAccountingHint: Ready to post the branch's sales.
wizard.doneLater: You can edit the branch any time with the Edit button on its card.

errors.nameTooLong: Branch name must be at most 100 characters
errors.nameDuplicate: A branch with this name already exists
errors.shortCodeTaken: This short code is used by another branch
errors.hoursOrder: Closing time must be after opening time
